PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/250925/008120.project_description: Symphony Heights is a modern residential tower that redefines urban living with contemporary elegance. Rising 20 storeys tall, this thoughtfully designed tower is set amidst 2 acres of land at Byrathi, off Hennur – one of North Bangalore’s most vibrant neighborhoods. The development enjoys excellent connectivity and proximity to schools, retail hubs, educational institutions, and business parks. With just 128 spacious 3 & 3.5 BHK residences, Symphony Heights is crafted to offer privacy, tranquility, and everyday ease. Designed with only 7 apartments per core, each home is filled with natural light, uninterrupted views, and seamless circulation. Spanning from 1,795 to 1,935 sq. ft., every residence is intelligently planned with generous proportions, premium specifications, smart zoning, and minimal shared walls – ensuring comfort and complete privacy. Every home opens to expansive balconies that extend the living and dining areas, offering uninterrupted views and greater privacy. At Symphony Heights, private and community life flow in perfect harmony. While the personal moments unfold in the quiet comfort of home, the community is thoughtfully layered across three distinct zones – the ground, podium, and rooftop. Each level offers a unique rhythm: from lively club facilities and interactive plazas to serene green pockets and wellness-inspired rooftop leisure spaces. Adding to the uniqueness is the elevated landscaped walkway – shielding parking areas below while connecting key amenities above, creating a refreshing space for leisure walks and casual connections with neighbors. Sustainability is at the heart of Symphony Heights. Green living is seamlessly integrated through water and energy conservation initiatives, efficient waste management systems, and eco-conscious planning, ensuring a lifestyle that is as responsible as it is elevated.
